Without access to advanced weapons or vehicles, they rely on ambush and ferocity in close combat to win. In the beginning, they were a collection of nomadic tribes until they discovered the wreckage of alien ships on their planet. Soon after, they made contact with the other species of Sirius, and were suddenly thrust from tribal hunters into the space age. Now the Jackals’ way of life has been forever changed, as they have begun to migrate to the stars. The Jackals’ home world was long left uncharted due to the unique properties of their home system’s sun. Radiation from their sun reflected from the atmosphere interfered with the electronic scanners ... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/jackals) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Scrapper: When attacking, targets must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6 when blocking hits from this model's weapons. ### Special Rules Ambushing Piercing Shot: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule. Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Crossing Attack(X): Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Destructive: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4). Fortified: When units where all models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0). Melee Evasion: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where all models have this rule. Mind Control: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which must take a morale test. If failed you may move it by up to 6" in a straight line in any direction. Morale Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Precise: Gets +1 to hit when attacking. Precision Tag(X): Once per game, during this model's activation, pick one enemy unit within 24" and in line of sight of it, and place X markers on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove markers from their target before rolling to hit to get +Y to hit rolls, where Y is the number of removed markers. Repel Ambushers: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit. Shatter: Against units where most models have Tough(3) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2). Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Strafing: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). ### Aura Special Rules Precision Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to hit rolls in melee. Ranged Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Ranged Shrouding. Scout Aura: This model and its unit get Scout. Scrapper Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Scrapper Boost. Stealth Aura: This model and its unit get Stealth. Unpredictable Shooter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Shooter. Read more ### Spells Psy-Hunter (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Scrapper Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Power Maw (1): Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 1 hit with AP(2) each. Mind Shaper (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which get -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply). Quill Blast (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with Shatter. Power Field (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Shielded once (next time the effect would apply). Feral Strike (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 3 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). ### Units ### Heroes Elite Veteran [1] Qua 4+Def 4+ 50pts Elite Shotgun(12", A3, AP(1)), CCW(A1) Hero,
